written.headline: Pangram launches Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 AI detection models
written.summary: Pangram released two computer‑vision models—Image 1.0 for still images and Image Flash 1.0 for video—claiming 99.2% detection of AI‑generated images with 0.27% false‑positives and 98.7% accuracy on the DF26 video benchmark.

written.headline: TeraWulf secures Google credit backstop for Anthropic Kentucky data center project
written.summary: TeraWulf announced a credit backstop agreement with Google to support debt financing for its Justified Data Campus in Hawesville, Kentucky, tied to roughly $19 billion of Anthropic lease commitments and slated to be operational in the second half of 2027.

written.headline: AMD records $1.1 billion non‑cash charge from OpenAI, Meta AI chip warrants
written.summary: AMD logged a $1.1 billion non‑cash charge in Q3 as it began accounting for stock warrants tied to AI chip supply agreements with OpenAI and Meta. The warrants could let the two companies buy up to 10% of AMD if performance milestones are met.
